Name: Micomi's Tile Paths
Author: MicomiBite
Description:
[size=3]Feeling a tad limited by the base game's path options, I was inspired to create my own!

If you're looking for a bit more variety in your running surfaces, these tiles might help! They all come with subtle color adjustments to match with the current season, too.

Currently, this adds 30 new path textures to choose from (8 cobblestone, 4 gravel, 12 crystal, and 6 wood paths). More smoothly connected variants of the wood ones are included too. If I find the time to create more of my ideas, this number may increase through updates.

This is my very first mod, so I'm a bit excited, please let me know if you encounter any issues![/size]

[size=4]♡[/size]
